initial.score: per-game equal MAPE and 80% interval score; session bootstrap
initial.qualification: development experiment only; no position likelihood, no prospective claim

refinement.trigger: Any arm: either seed ESS<500/status not ok, point gap>2.5%, or quantile gap>5%
refinement.policy: Rerun all three arms with equal larger budgets and two seeds; keep unresolved cases

refinement.criterion: ancestor ESS<200 or two-seed point gap>2.5% or quantile gap>5%

initial.order: uniform conditional on multiset and pooled random reveals; fixed observed indices
initial.row_policy: replace empirical row likelihood with exact generated height; no double counting
initial.proposal_tilt: exp(empirical row loglik) + 0.01; positive support floor; absolute mass correction

refinement.criterion: any spatial arm ancestor ESS<200, point gap>2.5%, quantile gap>5%, or no support

qualification: Historical development replay only; no prospective validation or default model promotion.
